# MV.tech

> MV.tech is a remote-first data engineering, software development and AI consultancy based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Founded in 2022 and led by Meet Vaghasia, the company provides engineering projects, offshore data and analytics capacity, embedded specialists and technology recruitment for clients worldwide. Collaboration hours, scope and commercial terms are agreed per engagement.

This is a factual index of the company's public website. The linked pages contain the full service descriptions and current engagement details. It supplements the HTML website and XML sitemap; it is not a search-engine submission or an assurance of inclusion in AI answers.

## Company and contact

- Brand and legal name published on the website: MV.tech. The company also uses MV Tech, MVTech, MV Tech Solutions and MV Tech Data Solutions. These names identify this company only when associated with mvtech.solutions and the profiles below; other similarly named businesses may be unrelated.
- Official website: https://mvtech.solutions/
- Founder: Meet Vaghasia, Founder & Lead Engineer.
- Base: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, 380061. Remote delivery worldwide, with client visits when needed.
- Team: 10–15 specialists, as stated on the About page.
- Company registration published on the website: GSTIN 24BZMPV4008F1ZA.
- Email: contact@mvtech.solutions

## Data engineering and analytics services

- [Offshore data engineering team](https://mvtech.solutions/services/offshore-data-engineering-team/): dedicated data engineering and analytics capacity from India for pipelines, cloud warehouses, BI, migration and data quality work. Delivery starts with a written first milestone and agreed timezone overlap.
- [Data engineering and ETL consulting](https://mvtech.solutions/services/data-engineering/): Python and SQL ingestion pipelines, BigQuery, Snowflake, Amazon Redshift, PostgreSQL, Azure Data Factory, transformation layers, dimensional modelling, data quality and reconciliation.
- [Data warehouse migration](https://mvtech.solutions/services/data-warehouse-migration/): legacy database and spreadsheet reporting migration to cloud warehouses; source discovery, dependency analysis, source-to-target mapping, staged reconciliation, dashboard repointing and cutover planning.
- [Business intelligence and dashboards](https://mvtech.solutions/services/business-intelligence/): Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio and Streamlit reporting; semantic models, agreed KPI definitions, self-service datasets, refresh performance and reporting-layer governance.
- [Blockchain and on-chain analytics](https://mvtech.solutions/services/blockchain-data-analytics/): cross-chain ingestion, transaction and event decoding, token identification, wallet analytics and reconciliation datasets, with an audit trail for manual overrides.

## AI, software and automation services

- [AI consulting, automation and RAG](https://mvtech.solutions/services/ai-consulting/): internal knowledge assistants grounded in approved documents, retrieval-augmented generation, model integration, evaluated agent workflows and human approval for consequential actions.
- [MCP servers and AI connectors](https://mvtech.solutions/services/mcp-and-ai-connectors/): Model Context Protocol servers, custom connectors and plugins, access to databases and business APIs, OAuth, managed secrets, permission-aware retrieval and controlled tools for assistants.
- [Custom software and web applications](https://mvtech.solutions/services/custom-software/): business web applications, client portals, internal tools and data apps using TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, REST APIs and PostgreSQL.
- [Workflow automation and API integration](https://mvtech.solutions/services/workflow-automation/): scheduled workflows, webhooks, REST and OAuth integrations, Google Apps Script and Google Sheets automation, with validation, retries, logs and monitoring.

## Engineering capacity and hiring

- [IT staff augmentation](https://mvtech.solutions/services/it-staff-augmentation/): senior data, BI, software, cloud, automation, AI and blockchain-data specialists embedded in a client's team with agreed capacity and overlap hours.
- [Technology recruitment](https://mvtech.solutions/services/technology-recruitment/): engineer-led hiring support for permanent data, analytics, AI, software and cloud roles. The client makes the hiring decision and employs the successful candidate.
- [How remote consulting works](https://mvtech.solutions/remote-consulting/): scoped projects, embedded consultants and recruitment; collaboration windows for North America, the UK, Europe, the Gulf and Asia-Pacific. Overlap is agreed per engagement and does not imply 24/7 support.

## Practical buyer guides

- [Insights](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/): index of practical engineering and buying guides by Meet Vaghasia.
- [Choosing a data consultancy for an offshore team](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/data-consultancy-company-for-offshore-team/): scope, delivery fit, responsibilities and first-milestone planning.
- [Questions before hiring a remote data engineering consultancy](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/questions-to-ask-before-hiring-a-remote-data-engineering-consultancy/): technical evaluation, communication, ownership, access and delivery checks.
- [RAG versus fine-tuning for internal knowledge assistants](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/rag-vs-fine-tuning-for-internal-knowledge-assistants/): choosing an approach based on knowledge freshness, traceability and model behaviour.
- [Staff augmentation versus project consulting versus recruitment](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/staff-augmentation-vs-project-consulting-vs-recruitment/): comparison of responsibility, control and engagement fit.
- [Timezone overlap with an India-based engineering team](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/timezone-overlap-with-an-india-based-engineering-team/): agreeing working hours and accounting for daylight saving in the client's location.
- [What an MCP server is and when a business should build one](https://mvtech.solutions/insights/what-is-an-mcp-server-and-when-should-a-business-build-one/): business-system access for AI assistants, integration scope and operating controls.

## Commercial and experience context

- Pricing is scoped per engagement. No public rate card, fixed savings percentage or guaranteed availability is published.
- Projects begin after scope is agreed in writing. A first milestone includes deliverables, acceptance criteria and collaboration hours.
- Company experience references describe work by team members, directly or through talent platforms. They are not endorsements, sponsorships or current partnerships.
- The company's 2022 founding date is distinct from the founder's and team's earlier professional experience.
